# Learning Pipeline Overseer Report
**Generated**: 2026-04-17 | **Window**: Last 48h

## Summary

The learning pipeline has a **critical systemic failure**: 4 of 5 jobs have never executed. The evolution system is permanently gate-blocked.

## Job Status

**reflection-trigger** — Working. 12 runs/48h, 174 total, 100% success. Opus every 4h, avg 72-157s. Git diffs confirm real MEMORY.md updates (Slack regression notes, version changelog). 25 quota skips total.

**insight-harvest** — Broken. 0 runs, 99 gate skips. Gate calls /evolution/learnings?applied=false without auth. Server returns 401, empty body, JSON parse fails, exit 1. 7 unapplied learnings exist but are invisible to this job.

**evolution-proposal-evaluate** — Broken. 0 runs, 109 gate skips. Same auth problem. Also circular: no proposals exist because insight-harvest never ran.

**evolution-proposal-implement** — Broken. 0 runs, 105 gate skips.

**evolution-overdue-check** — Broken. 0 runs, 129 gate skips. Haiku model, cheapest job, never runs.

## Root Cause

Gate commands run without auth token. The pattern `curl -sf http://localhost:4042/evolution/learnings?applied=false` hits an auth-protected endpoint, gets a 401, produces empty stdout, Python JSONDecodeError, exit 1. Verified fix: same call with Authorization header returns 7 unapplied learnings.

## Impact

- 7 learnings (LRN-001 through LRN-007) queued unapplied since March-April 2026
- Zero evolution proposals ever generated
- Agent does not self-evolve via the structured pipeline
- Looks healthy in job dashboards (0 failures) — silent failure

## Fix Required

Job scheduler should inject INSTAR_AUTH_TOKEN into gate execution environment. Quick patch: prepend auth token read to gate commands in jobs.json.

After fix: manually trigger insight-harvest to flush 7 queued learnings.

## Reflection-Trigger Opus Cost

Justified. Task requires judgment about novelty of insights. Short durations (59s min) suggest most runs correctly identify nothing to write. Optional optimization: Haiku pre-screen to gate opus call.
